ordered_branches.explanation: Privately verified operations index/statistics/all and modes smart/dummy; invalid non-NULL mode resets smart, NULL mode remainsNULL. Invalid/NULL operation prints help but does not return: it can still create AzureSQLMaintenanceLog even LogToTable=0, and optional logging/retention still runs. Index discovery uses LIMITED physical stats and index types1/2; smart queues page_count>40 and fragmentation>=5, reorganizing strictly>5 and<30, so exactly5 rebuilds. Dummy means broad real maintenance, not dry-run; OR dummy bypasses preceding queue predicates. Partition rows can produce repeated whole-index commands because partition_number is not inserted into command. Online-support heuristic checks index_id>=1000 only within prefiltered temp data. Statistics selects non-sys rows with modifications or dummy and forms rows/modification info, which can divide by zero. Unordered DELETE TOP1 queue executes each command inside TRY/CATCH, optionally logs command/status using SCOPE_IDENTITY, then continues after errors. Keeps three most recent distinct operation times when logging. The _1 payload uses REORGANIZE WITH(ONLINE=OFF,MAXDOP=8), REBUILD MAXDOP=8 with ONLINE ON/OFF choice, and UPDATE STATISTICS without FULLSCAN. The emitted REORGANIZE options are retained as source evidence; successful engine acceptance is not established.

if @LogToTable=1 insert into AzureSQLMaintenanceLog values(@OperationTime,null,null,sysdatetime(),sysdatetime(),N'<literal:31>' +@operation + N'<literal:32>' + @mode + N'<literal:33>' + cast(@KeepXOperationInLog as varchar(10)) + N'<literal:34>' )
left join sys.indexes idxs on i.object_id = idxs.object_id and i.index_id = idxs.index_id
where idxs.type in (1/* [comment omitted] */,2/* [comment omitted] */) /* [comment omitted] */
order by i.avg_fragmentation_in_percent desc, page_count desc
